status: Source. Every message Taskiem sends people over WhatsApp, USSD and SMS; context says where.

agent.share_own.text: Share your own number with the button, not someone else's. Send AGREE and the code again to start over.

agent.stopped.text: Done. {agents} can no longer work on your business.

invoice.chat.limit.text: Too many account numbers were given for invoice {number} in the last hour. Use the last one, or try again later on the invoice's page:

money.channel.upload.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: money from an uploaded bank statement, as a channel name

money.daily.in.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: money that came in and settled, like ₦25,000

money.daily.in_pending.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: money that came in and settled, and money still on its way (pending)

money.daily.invoices.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: several invoices paid that day, and what was paid on them

money.daily.invoices_none.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: no invoice paid that day

money.daily.invoices_one.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: one invoice paid that day

money.daily.leaks.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: several leaks (money the business may be losing) found that day, and how much

money.daily.leaks_none.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: no leak found that day

money.daily.leaks_one.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: one leak (money the business may be losing) found that day

money.daily.link.context: The daily money summary sent to a business's owners on WhatsApp or Telegram each morning: the link to the Money page in the web app

money.daily.riders.context: The daily money summary: the heading before each rider's line (deliveries, cash, what they owe)

money.rider.delivered.context: A rider's line in the daily money summary: how many deliveries they made

money.rider.door.context: A rider's line in the daily money summary: paid by transfer at the customer's door

money.rider.cash.context: A rider's line in the daily money summary: cash they took at the door

money.rider.remitted.context: A rider's line in the daily money summary: cash they handed in to the business

money.rider.owes.context: A rider's line in the daily money summary: the cash they still owe the business

money.rider.rated.context: A rider's line in the daily money summary: the average rating customers gave their deliveries

money.daily.school.text: School fees ({term}): {collected} collected, {outstanding} outstanding, {cleared}% of students cleared.
money.daily.school.context: The daily money summary's line for a school (the Schools area on): what was collected for school fees that day, what the term's invoices still owe, and the share of the term's students cleared to come in; {term} is like First term 2026/2027

reach.about.text: This chat sends you updates from {businesses}. Send STOP to stop the latest one.
reach.about.context: Someone outside a business wrote to the bot or number that sends them its updates; {businesses} are those that do

reach.code_invalid.text: This link has expired or was used already. Open the business's link again to get a new one.
reach.code_invalid.context: Someone sent a link's code that is unknown, used or older than seven days

reach.linked.text: You'll get updates from {business} here. Send STOP to stop them.
reach.linked.context: Someone outside a business linked this chat to get its updates

reach.number_unreachable.text: Sorry, {business} cannot send updates to this number here.
reach.number_unreachable.context: The phone a Telegram account shared is not one Taskiem reaches (another country)

reach.resumed.text: You'll get updates from {business} here again. Send STOP to stop them.
reach.resumed.context: Someone sent START after stopping a business's updates

reach.share_number.text: To get updates from {business} here, tap Share my number below. Telegram sends the number on your account, so {business} knows it is yours.
reach.share_number.context: Someone opened a business's standing link on Telegram; next they share their own number

reach.share_number_request.text: You'll get updates from {business} about your request here. To get all their updates here, tap Share my number below: Telegram sends the number on your account, so {business} knows it is yours.
reach.share_number_request.context: Someone opened the link on a form's thank-you page on Telegram; their phone was not checked, so they are asked to share it

reach.share_own.text: Please share your own number, with the Share my number button below.
reach.share_own.context: Someone shared a contact that is not their own number

reach.stopped.text: You will no longer get updates from {business} here. Send START to get them again.

reach.stopped_none.text: You are not getting updates from anyone here.
reach.stopped_none.context: Someone sent STOP but no business sends them updates here

ready.table.context: Readiness: a data table the workflow uses does not exist

{list}
wa.table.pick_again.context: add: the pick was not a number on the list

wa.table.too_many.text: You have added several rows just now. Wait a minute, then try again.
wa.table.too_many.context: Rate limit on rows added from chat

wa.table.unavailable.text: Data tables cannot be reached right now. Try again in a minute.
wa.table.unavailable.context: Xenibase or the connection could not be used

wa.table.which.context: add: several tables match; {list} is numbered

wa.too_fast.text: You are sending messages too quickly. Wait a minute, then try again.
wa.too_fast.context: Rate limit on a number's messages

wa.unbound.text: This number is not linked to a Taskiem account. To use Taskiem here, sign in, open {where}, add this number under WhatsApp, then type or send back the code we send you.
wa.unbound.context: A number linked to no one wrote

signup.offer.text:
Hello! Taskiem runs your business's errands from this chat: payments, invoices, stock, reminders, your shop page. Do you want to start, for free?

To chat in another language, type its name: {languages}.
signup.offer.context: A stranger wrote to Taskiem's shared number or bot; three buttons follow. {languages} lists the languages on

signup.button_start.context: Button, at most 20 characters: start signing up

signup.button_have.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the person already has a Taskiem account

signup.button_no.context: Button, at most 20 characters: not now

signup.later.text: No problem. Send *start* any time to begin.
signup.later.context: The person said not now to signing up

signup.no_org.text: Your Taskiem account has no business at the moment. Do you want to start one?
signup.no_org.context: A linked person belongs to no business; buttons to start one follow

signup.country.text: Signing up from chat is not open in your country yet. You can sign up on Taskiem's website instead.
signup.country.context: Sign-up is not open in the number's country

signup.too_many.text: This number has made {count} businesses today, the most for one day. Try again tomorrow.
signup.too_many.context: Daily limit of businesses per number; {count} is the limit

signup.busy.text: We are busy signing people up right now. Please try again in an hour.
signup.busy.context: The deployment's hourly sign-up limit is reached

signup.terms.text:
Taskiem keeps your business's records and the details you give it. Read how, and the terms: {link}

Reply *Yes* to agree and start. (To chat in another language, type its name: {languages}.)
signup.terms.context: Before anything is made: the terms and privacy notice, Yes and No buttons follow. {link} is where to read them; {languages} the languages on

signup.declined.text: Nothing was made. Send *start* if you change your mind.
signup.declined.context: The person said No to the terms: nothing was made

signup.cancelled.text: Stopped: nothing was made. Send *start* to begin again.
signup.cancelled.context: The person cancelled signing up: nothing was made

signup.ask_business.text: What is your business called? (Send *cancel* to stop at any point.)

signup.ask_sells.text:
What do you sell or do? Reply with a number:
1. Food
2. Provisions
3. Fashion
4. Phones and gadgets
5. School
6. Salon
7. Services
8. Something else

signup.ask_pays.text:
How do customers pay you? Reply with the numbers that fit, like 1 2 3:
1. Cash
2. Bank transfer
3. POS
4. Paystack
5. Moniepoint
6. OPay
signup.ask_pays.context: Sign-up question 4, a numbered list, several may be picked

signup.ask_contact.text: Last step: tap *Share my number* so we know it is you and can text you when Telegram can't. Send *cancel* to stop.
signup.ask_contact.context: Telegram: the person must share their own number with the keyboard button

signup.contact_own.text: That is not your own number. Tap *Share my number* to share yours.
signup.contact_own.context: Telegram: the contact shared is not the person's own

signup.number_taken.text: This number already uses Taskiem. To use Taskiem here too, sign in, open {where}, and link this chat.
signup.number_taken.context: The number already belongs to a Taskiem account; nothing was made. {where} is the account page

signup.business_bad.text: A business name needs 2 to 80 characters, and no links or email addresses. What is your business called?

signup.name_bad.text: A name needs at most 80 characters, and no links or email addresses. What is your name?

signup.done.context: The business is made (no trial). {business} is its name

signup.done_trial.text: Done: *{business}* is on Taskiem, free for {days} days.
signup.done_trial.context: The business is made, with a free trial of {days} days. {business} is its name

signup.starters.text: Here are three things businesses like yours start with:
signup.starters.context: Before the three templates offered to a new business

signup.own_words.text: Tap one, or say what you want in your own words.

signup.pin_hint.text: This chat is your account. Send *pin* to set a six-digit PIN that keeps it yours.
signup.pin_hint.context: After signing up on WhatsApp: the chat PIN

signup.tpl.daily-reminder.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the daily-reminder template

signup.tpl.sales-day-total.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the sales-day-total template

signup.tpl.school-fee-reminders.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the school-fee-reminders template

signup.tpl.send-invoice.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the send-invoice template

signup.tpl.pos-daily-summary.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the pos-daily-summary template

signup.tpl.payment-receipt-whatsapp.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the payment-receipt-whatsapp template

signup.tpl.low-stock-alert.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the low-stock-alert template

signup.tpl.stock-count-reminder.context: Button, at most 20 characters: the stock-count-reminder template

dormant.form_title.context: Title of the PIN form that wakes a dormant chat

dormant.prove.text: This chat was quiet for {days} days, so Taskiem stopped using it until you prove it is still you. Enter your chat PIN in the form.
dormant.prove.context: A dormant binding wrote and has a PIN: the PIN form follows. {days} is the dormancy period

dormant.relink.text: This chat was quiet for {days} days, so Taskiem stopped using it until you prove it is still you. Sign in, open {where} and link it again, or use Taskiem from your other chat. If it stays unproven, it is unlinked after another {days} days.
dormant.relink.context: A dormant binding wrote, with no PIN to prove it. {days} is the dormancy period, {where} the account page

chatpin.web.text: Set your PIN in the web app, at {where}: it asks for your passkey, authenticator or password first.
chatpin.web.context: pin: the person has a password, passkey or authenticator, so sets the PIN on the web. {where} is the account page

chatpin.set_already.text: You have a chat PIN already. To change it, sign in on the web (send sign in for a link), add a passkey or an authenticator, then change it on your Account page at {where}.
chatpin.set_already.context: 'pin' in chat from someone who has a chat PIN already: changing it is not done from the chat. {where} is the web app's Account page

chatpin.not_here.text: The chat PIN cannot be set from here yet: set it from WhatsApp, where Taskiem sends a secure form.
chatpin.not_here.context: pin: the PIN form cannot be sent on this channel

chatpin.form_title.context: Title of the PIN form that sets the chat PIN

chatpin.form.text: Choose a six-digit PIN in the form. Keep it to yourself: it proves this chat is yours, and approves what asks for it.
chatpin.form.context: Message with the PIN form that sets the chat PIN

chatpin.summary.text: Six digits that keep this chat yours
chatpin.summary.context: Summary line in the PIN form

connect.hint.text: Send *connect {service}* to connect it from here.
connect.hint.context: After something a draft needs: how to connect the service from the chat. {service} is its id, typed as is

connect.link.text:
Connect {service} here: {link}

The link works once, for {minutes} minutes, and only for you. Never send a key in this chat: type it on that page.
connect.link.context: A one-time connect link. {service} is the service, {link} the link, {minutes} how long it works

connect.link_button.text: Tap the button below to connect {service}. It works once, for {minutes} minutes, and only for you. Never send a key in this chat: type it in the form.
connect.link_button.context: Telegram: the connect page is on the button below. {service} is the service, {minutes} how long it works

connect.button.context: Telegram button that opens the connect page. {service} is the service

connect.denied.text: Only someone who manages connections in {org} can connect services. Ask the owner.
connect.denied.context: The person may not connect services. {org} is the business

connect.unknown.text: Taskiem has no service called {service}. Check the name, like *connect paystack*.
connect.unknown.context: connect named a service Taskiem does not have. {service} is what was typed

connect.done.context: A service was connected from a connect link. {service} is the service, {org} the business

connect.carry_on.context: After a connection, carrying on with the draft it was for. {name} is the workflow

connect.key_in_chat.text: That looks like a secret key, so Taskiem did not keep or use it. Keys go only in the secure form: send *connect* and the service. The chat app has the key now, so replace it at the service and use the new one.
connect.key_in_chat.context: A key was sent as a chat message: it was not kept or used

connect.form.text: Tap the button to connect {service}. Type the key in the form, never in this chat: Taskiem checks it with {service} before saving it.
connect.form.context: With the WhatsApp key form. {service} is the service

connect.form_intro.text: Copy each value from {service} and paste it here. Taskiem checks it with {service} before saving it.
connect.form_intro.context: The first line of the WhatsApp key form. {service} is the service

connect.form_cta.context: Button that opens the WhatsApp key form, at most 30 characters

terms.ask.text:
Taskiem has terms and a privacy notice you have not agreed to yet: {link}

Tap *I agree*, or reply *I agree*. Taskiem carries on either way.
terms.ask.context: An account from before the terms is asked once; an I agree button follows. {link} is where to read them

terms.button.context: Button, at most 20 characters: agree to the terms

terms.thanks.text: Thank you: your agreement is recorded.
terms.thanks.context: The person agreed to the terms

wd.ai.text: Ask the AI model, with personal data hidden from it
wd.ai.context: Read-back: an ai step; personal data is replaced by placeholders before the model sees it

wd.ai.through.text: Ask the AI model, which sees {fields} as they are; other personal data is hidden from it
wd.ai.through.context: Read-back: an ai step that lets some input fields reach the model unmasked; {fields} is a comma-separated list of field names

wd.alongside.context: Read-back of a built workflow: a branch that runs alongside others; {name} is the tenant's

wd.and.context: Read-back: the last of a list of days; {list} is comma-separated

wd.approval.policy.context: Read-back: approval under a named policy; {policy} is the tenant's

wd.approval.role_many.text: Ask {count} people with the {role} role to approve
wd.approval.role_many.context: Read-back: approval by several people with a role

wd.approval.role_one.context: Read-back: approval by one person with a role; {role} is the tenant's

wd.approval.timeout.context: Read-back: how long an approval waits; {approval} is the approval line

wd.callback.text: Wait for the other system to call back
wd.callback.context: Read-back: a callback step with the default wait

wd.callback_for.text: Wait up to {duration} for the other system to call back
wd.callback_for.context: Read-back: a callback step; {duration} is read aloud (wd.unit.*)

wd.capability.text: {what} with whichever payments account is connected
wd.capability.context: Read-back: a capability step with no connection named; {what} is the capability, e.g. Pay a bank account

wd.capability.via.context: Read-back: a capability step; {what} is the capability, {connection} the connection's name

wd.code_language.context: Read-back: the tenant's own code; {language} is a programming language

wd.connector.context: Read-back: a connector step; {action} and {connector} are the connector's own names

wd.container_named.context: Read-back: a container step; {image} is the image's name

wd.effect.and.context: Read-back: joins the last of what a template does: "moves money, waits for a person and waits for something to happen"

wd.effect.event.context: Read-back: the template or workflow waits for an event (a payment, a reply, a callback)

wd.effect.moves_money.context: Read-back: what a template or workflow does at most: it pays, refunds or collects

wd.effect.person.text: waits for a person to approve or answer
wd.effect.person.context: Read-back: the template or workflow has an approval or a form step

wd.effect.read.context: Read-back: what a template or workflow does at most: it changes nothing

wd.effect.write.context: Read-back: what a template or workflow does at most: it writes somewhere

wd.foreach.text: For each item in the list:
wd.foreach.context: Read-back: steps repeated for each item

wd.foreach_limited.text: For each item in the list (at most {count} at a time):
wd.foreach_limited.context: Read-back: steps repeated for each item, {count} at a time at most

wd.form.context: Read-back: a form step that sends someone a form and waits for the answers; {title} is the tenant's

wd.form.email.text: Ask someone, by their email address, to fill in “{title}”
wd.form.email.context: Read-back: a form step whose link goes to an email address from the run; {title} is the tenant's

wd.form.phone.text: Ask someone, by their phone number, to fill in “{title}”
wd.form.phone.context: Read-back: a form step whose link goes to a phone number from the run; {title} is the tenant's

wd.form.role.text: Ask members with the {role} role to fill in “{title}”
wd.form.role.context: Read-back: a form step for members with a role; {role} and {title} are the tenant's

wd.form.timeout.context: Read-back: how long a form step waits for the answers; {form} is the form step's line

wd.http.context: Read-back: a call to a web service

wd.http_host.context: Read-back: a call to a web service; {host} and {method} are technical, keep them

wd.http_service.context: Read-back: a call to a web service whose address is worked out when it runs

wd.if.context: Read-back: one path of a decision; {name} is the tenant's

wd.on_error.context: Read-back: steps run when the step above fails

wd.only_when.context: Read-back: a step that runs only when its condition holds; {step} says what it does

wd.or.context: Read-back: joins event names (keep the spaces)

wd.otherwise.context: Read-back: the path taken when no other applies

wd.parallel.text: Do these at the same time:
wd.parallel.context: Read-back: branches run at the same time

wd.respond.text: Answer the request that started this
wd.respond.context: Read-back: a respond step (the webhook caller gets this answer)

wd.schedule.daily.context: Read-back: a schedule; {time} is HH:MM and {tz} a time zone such as Africa/Lagos

wd.schedule.days.context: Read-back: a schedule; {days} are day names (wd.day.*)

wd.schedule.hourly_at.context: Read-back: a schedule; {minute} is minutes past the hour

wd.schedule.last_day.text: On the last day of every month at {time} ({tz} time)

wd.schedule.monthly.text: On the {day} of every month at {time} ({tz} time)
wd.schedule.monthly.context: Read-back: a schedule; {day} is the day of the month: '25th' in English, the number alone in other languages

wd.schedule.raw.context: Read-back: a schedule shown as written; {cron} is the expression

wd.schedule.raw_local.context: Read-back: a schedule shown as written; {cron} is the expression

wd.schedule.weekdays.text: Every weekday (Monday to Friday) at {time} ({tz} time)

wd.signal_named.context: Read-back: waits for a named event; {event} is the tenant's

wd.subflow.text: Run your workflow: {workflow}, and wait for it to finish
wd.subflow.context: Read-back: a subflow step that waits for the child run; {workflow} is its name

wd.subflow.nowait.text: Start your workflow: {workflow}, and carry on
wd.subflow.nowait.context: Read-back: a subflow step that does not wait for the child run

wd.template.context: Read-back: a template step (a callable template used inside the workflow); {template} is the template's title, e.g. Run payroll

wd.template.does.context: Read-back: as wd.template, with what the template does (wd.effect.*), e.g. "moves money and waits for a person to approve or answer"

wd.transform.text: Prepare the data for the next steps
wd.transform.context: Read-back: a step that reshapes data

wd.trigger.capability_event.context: Read-back: started by a payment event from whichever payments account is connected; {events} are the events, e.g. A payout failed; the money is back

wd.trigger.database_change.context: Read-back: started by a database change

wd.trigger.event.context: Read-back: started by a connector's event; {trigger} is its name

wd.trigger.event_reports.context: Read-back: started by a connector's events; {connector} and {events} are names

wd.trigger.form.text: When someone fills in the form “{title}”
wd.trigger.form.context: Read-back: started by a hosted form anyone with its link can fill in; {title} is the tenant's

wd.trigger.form_link.text: When someone fills in the form “{title}” (only with a link sent to them)
wd.trigger.form_link.context: Read-back: started by a hosted form opened by one-time links; {title} is the tenant's

wd.trigger.form_members.text: When someone fills in the form “{title}” (members only)
wd.trigger.form_members.context: Read-back: started by a hosted form only signed-in members can fill in; {title} is the tenant's

wd.trigger.invoice_paid.text: When one of your invoices is paid in full
wd.trigger.invoice_paid.context: Read-back: started when one of the business's invoices to its customers is paid in full

wd.trigger.invoice_payment.text: When a payment is counted towards one of your invoices
wd.trigger.invoice_payment.context: Read-back: started by every payment counted towards one of the business's invoices, paid in full or not

wd.trigger.other.context: Read-back: started some other way; {type} is the trigger's type

wd.trigger.polling.context: Read-back: checks a connector for new items every {interval}

wd.trigger.storefront.text: When someone sends the storefront's {form} form
wd.trigger.storefront.context: Read-back: started by a form on the business's public storefront; {form} is order, enquiry or callback

wd.trigger.ussd.text: When someone dials the USSD code
wd.trigger.ussd.context: Read-back: started by a USSD session

wd.trigger.webhook.text: When your system calls this workflow's web address

wd.trigger.webhook_checked.text: When your system calls this workflow's web address (checked with {auth})
wd.trigger.webhook_checked.context: Read-back: what starts the workflow; {auth} is how calls are checked (hmac, bearer...)

wd.trigger.webhook_unsigned.text: When your system calls this workflow's web address (no signature check)
wd.trigger.webhook_unsigned.context: Read-back: what starts the workflow (calls are not signed)

wd.trigger.whatsapp.text: When a message arrives on WhatsApp
wd.trigger.whatsapp.context: Read-back: started by a WhatsApp message

wd.wait_for.context: Read-back: a pause; {duration} is read aloud (wd.unit.*)

wd.wait_until.context: Read-back: a pause until a set time

wd.workflow.context: Read-back: a template step that uses one of the business's own workflows; {template} is its name

wd.workflow.does.context: Read-back: as wd.workflow, with what it does (wd.effect.*)
